say: Use WhatsApp for speed: quick questions, orders, delivery updates and group news.
Use email for anything formal or anything you may need to prove later.
A useful rule: if you would be upset to lose the message, email it, then mention it on WhatsApp. For example, I have just emailed you the quotation for the 50 T-shirts.
WhatsApp Business is a free app for small businesses. Fill in your profile with name, address and hours.

say: Before a video call, run this check. Phone charged above 50 percent. Data or Wi-Fi confirmed. Light in front of you, because light behind you turns your face into a shadow. A quiet spot with earphones. App updated and link open.
Prop the phone at eye level, and join two to three minutes early.
During the call, stay muted unless you are speaking. The first time you speak, say your name, for example, This is Bisi from Ogun state.

cards.d: Unmute, speak, then mute again. Say your name the first time you speak.
Ask questions in the chat, or raise your hand in a large meeting and wait to be called.
Free Zoom meetings end after 40 minutes. Free Meet group calls end at 60 minutes.

say: Drive keeps one online copy that everyone works on. When you share, choose what each person can do. A Viewer can only read.

cards.d: Can open and read only. Good for final reports, price lists and notices.
Can read and add comments, but not change the text. Good for reviewers.
Can change, delete and share. Only for team members writing it with you.

say: A Commenter can add comments but cannot change the text. Good for a manager giving feedback.

say: An Editor can change, delete and share the file.
And keep anything with names, phone numbers or money figures on Restricted, so only the people you added can open it.

say: For example, Blessing sells lace in Aba. A commenter says her lace is overpriced. She replies once, calmly, explains her quality and free delivery in Aba, and invites him to message her for a close-up video.
She does not argue, and hides a later insulting comment. Never send payment details in a public comment, and never post other people's children or locations without permission.
Before you post, use the billboard test: would you be comfortable seeing it on a billboard beside your name?

To remember. WhatsApp for speed, email for records. Confirm agreements in writing. On calls, light in front and muted unless speaking. In Drive, choose the right role and keep private files Restricted. And on social media, reply once and calmly.
